name: Russian Eastern Outskirts
alt: Government of the Russian Eastern Outskirts

ledger.x: 1920, 16 January: "Grigory Semyonov announced in Chita the creation of the 'Government of the Russian Eastern Outskirts'" (infobox "Established: January 16 1920").

1920, 19 October: Red forces of the Far Eastern Republic begin advancing on Chita after the Japanese left it on 15 October; Semyonov passed his civil powers to a Provisional Eastern-Transbaikal Assembly in September.
1920, 22 October: Chita falls to the Red forces; the regime, "left without territory, collapsed" and the Far Eastern Republic takes Transbaikal.
1920, 22 October: fighting for Chita ends with its capture.
1920, 28 October: "Disestablished: October 28" (infobox, no year shown); the page says the regime "left without territory, collapsed" at the end of October.

certainty.note: The page names no districts; the Transbaikal frontier is the Chita oblast of the Far Eastern Republic dossier.
